text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa... It's not... It's not here!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: My phone! Where did it go?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Left the dorm, got some Hachimi, hit the 
shops, and then, and then... I can't 
remember!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Call for help on LANE... wait, I don't 
have my smartphone~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the end, her smartphone was found in 
her own room. Daitaku Helios was 
completely exhausted from searching for 
it...
